description: Project-authored synthetic news replay inspired only by the general pattern of public March 2023 banking-sector stress; not copied reporting or a claim about a real institution.

records.title: Aurora Bank funding pressure prompts credit downgrade review
records.text: Analysts reported a downgrade review after rapid deposit withdrawals widened Aurora Bank credit spread; contingency planning addressed restructuring risk, default exposure, and potential loss.

records.title: Aurora Bank explores restructuring as bond spread widens
records.text: Aurora Bank outlined emergency liquidity options while investors discussed a missed payment, possible default, and further downgrade after its bond spread moved sharply wider.
